snippet.title: Tomo: Endless Blue ► Official Reveal Trailer (ft. Ai Higuchi and Cécile Corbel)
snippet.description:
Check on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1891746870/tomoendlessblue

Tomo: Endless Blue is an open-world monster-taming action RPG.

Set sail through the Endless Blue, a living world of mysterious creatures: the Tomo. Team up with your companions in real-time combat, or simply enjoy daily life. Build vehicles and contraptions to explore procedurally generated islands and villages, and meet unique characters along the way.

More about the game: https://www.tomoendlessblue.com/

Pre-save digital single 'Endless Blue' here:
https://higuchiai.lnk.to/Endless_Blue

Please also join our Discord server to chat with the devs and be the first to know about features being developed! https://discord.gg/tomoendlessblue

Song: Endless Blue
Performed by: @AiHiguchiOfficial 
Composed by: @CecileCorbelOfficial and Simon Caby
Written by: @AiHiguchiOfficial
Mixed and mastered by: Simon Caby
Creative Director: Benjamin Devienne

Special thanks to SUPAMONKS for teaming up with us! ♥♥♥ 

Our socials:
Discord - https://discord.gg/tomoendlessblue
Twitter - https://twitter.com/tomoendlessblue
Instagram - https://instagram.com/tomoendlessblue
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@tomoendlessblue/
Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/tomoendlessblue.com
